question: In a 2019 study of chord sequences from 745 US hits, which moment gave listeners the most pleasure?
options: A predictable chord after a predictable run
A surprising chord after an unpredictable run
A surprising chord after a predictable run
answer: A surprising chord after a predictable run. Vincent Cheung and colleagues modelled 80,000 chords, played without melody or lyrics, and had listeners rate them. Surprise pleased when expectation was confident; a safe chord pleased after uncertainty; a shock inside confusion did little. A loop earns its twist by being predictable first.
move: A surprise only lands where there was a confident expectation to break.
ask: Where have I stopped expecting anything, so nothing can ever surprise me?
trap: Assuming more surprise always means more pleasure, whatever came before.
